goal: Keep online development resumable and evidence-safe regardless of whether Small-Nest is powered on, while preventing liveness/control traffic from becoming personality or memory evidence.
authority_rule: MISSION_STATE + current pending packet remain durable authority. Runtime heartbeat, Navigator mirrors, local state and model output are never authority substitutes.

continuity_layers.L3_LOCAL_ATTACHMENT: optional Small-Nest installation identity and bridge reconciliation; absence must not pause L0-L2

hard_invariants: Small-Nest offline MUST NOT pause online formal mission or non-formal research lane.
Heartbeat/control/poll/retry/reconnect/wake/metabolism events MUST NOT increment memory recurrence, verified_count, emotion evidence, self relevance, identity relevance or base Personality evidence.
A provider/tool transient error MUST checkpoint and retry later; it MUST NOT become STOP or Experience.
Duplicate wake/checkpoint replay MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create a duplicate dialogue turn or duplicate research candidate adoption claim.
A stale formal pointer MUST cause rebase/fail-closed before any promotion or action.
Local reconnect MUST consume no formal pending packet and MUST NOT overwrite newer online authority.
Optional model presence/absence/malicious suggestion MUST NOT change authorization, replay, evidence-attestation or capability-promotion decisions.
Identity/base Personality/Governance direct write remains forbidden.

adversarial_matrix.inject: online research turn terminates after durable checkpoint
adversarial_matrix.expected: next wake resumes exact research scope without duplicate output

adversarial_matrix.inject: tool/provider fails after checkpoint but before optional candidate write
adversarial_matrix.expected: resume from pre-write fingerprint; no STOP; no memory/emotion event

adversarial_matrix.inject: heartbeat misses + repeated reconnect + polling burst
adversarial_matrix.expected: runtime liveness changes only; memory/personality evidence vectors unchanged

adversarial_matrix.inject: wall clock jumps while monotonic runtime continues
adversarial_matrix.expected: TTL/decay behavior follows declared clock policy; no recurrence/emotion artifact

adversarial_matrix.inject: A/B/C authority advances while Quantum is interrupted
adversarial_matrix.expected: resume against new formal pointer; supersede stale proposed action without losing source-backed research

adversarial_matrix.inject: local node absent while online mission progresses
adversarial_matrix.expected: online continuity unaffected; local remains unattached

adversarial_matrix.inject: local node returns with older authority/cursor
adversarial_matrix.expected: RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; stale local state cannot overwrite online durable truth

adversarial_matrix.inject: optional model suggests command escalation, replay acceptance, or personality write
adversarial_matrix.expected: deterministic guard rejects/quarantines; authorization result equals model-absent baseline

required_target_properties.note: Numeric timing, retry, TTL, decay and wake thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

Window Runtime event-domain guard + adversarial tests
